textContent:
In Solaris's data space, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Before the malice inside the matrix annihilates everything, find it... and put an end to it.
 
✦Duration✦
Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans across multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases.
 
Duration of Endstate Matrix: From 2026-07-17 04:00 (server time)
※The second Endstate Matrix Challenge Cycle "Adversity Vanguard" lasts from Version 3.5 to Version 3.8.
 
✦Rewards✦
● Phase Rewards
Stability Accords: Astrite x150, Premium Resonance Potion x5, Premium Energy Core x5, Premium Sealed Tube x5, Shell Credit x240000
Singularity Expansion: Astrite x250, Until We Meet Again x1 (Exclusive Title), Modifier x10, Premium Tuner x100, Premium Sealed Tube x30, Premium Enclosure Tank III x20, and other Materials.
※Title: Until We Meet Again will remain valid until the conclusion of Version 3.5. You can obtain it again after the Phase Rewards reset by meeting the specific requirements.
 
● Cycle Rewards - Adversity Vanguard
Past the Endstate: Adversity Vanguard x1 (Sigil), Projection: Blade of a Thousand Arts x1 (Weapon Projection), Premium Tuner x300
※Duration of Adversity Vanguard's First Phase: 2026-07-17 04:00 (server time) - Before Version 3.6 Update Maintenance
 
✦Eligibility✦
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of Hazard Zone in Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after Version 3.2.
 
✦Event Rules✦
- In Endstate Matrix, your skills will be tested through intense combats. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.
- During Adversity Vanguard, complete the Cycle Tasks and Challenge Tasks to earn Encrypted Data and unlock exclusive rewards. Encrypted Data will be cleared at the end of the Cycle.
- Adversity Vanguard consists of 3 Cycle Tasks. Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. During Adversity Vanguard, up to 600 Encrypted Data can be obtained through Cycle Tasks.
- 4 Challenge Tasks are available in Phase 1. Starting from Phase 2, 3 Challenge Tasks will be available in each Challenge Phase. Challenge Tasks last for the duration of Adversity Vanguard.
- In Endstate Matrix, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge. Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion (Singularity Expansion unlocks after defeating all enemies in Stability Accords). In Stability Accords, you may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge. In Singularity Expansion, there is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will unlock the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.
- Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.
※In this gameplay, the same Weapon and Echo cannot be used by two different Resonators. If a Resonator equips a Weapon or Echo already used by a Resonator with a challenge record, the challenge cannot be started.
